_doc: IDEA-BANK-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: the front-door examples must be diverse and actually buildable). Every idea the front door suggests lives here with its domain, reach and the four system-test answers. scripts/build_idea_bank.py runs each one through the seed's own bootstrap stages (read, qualify, instrument) on a generated IDEA.md, refuses the bank when one fails or when the domains are not diverse, and writes site/idea-bank-data.js, which site/suggest.js and site/interview.js read. Edit this file, never the generated one.

ideas.text: A flood and heat alert page for our town that checks open weather data every hour and learns to warn earlier
ideas.keywords: flood heat weather alert town city storm warning climate safety
ideas.loop: open forecast and river data read hourly, alert issued or withdrawn, next reading compared with what happened
ideas.measure: hours of warning before each real event, and false alarms, target fewer each month
ideas.upkeep: weather sources, thresholds and local risks keep changing

ideas.text: A council-meeting tracker that summarises every agenda and tells residents about decisions near them
ideas.keywords: council government meeting agenda local residents planning decisions civic
ideas.loop: each new agenda read, summarised and matched to subscribers, then corrected when minutes are published
ideas.measure: agendas summarised within a day and corrections needed after minutes, target 0
ideas.upkeep: councils publish new agendas every week and change their formats

ideas.text: An air-quality watch for my neighbourhood that reads open sensor data and flags bad days before they happen
ideas.keywords: air quality pollution sensor environment health neighbourhood smoke asthma
ideas.loop: open sensor readings pulled hourly, forecast of bad days published, forecast scored against the next day
ideas.measure: share of bad-air days flagged a day ahead
ideas.upkeep: sensors go offline and new data sources appear

ideas.text: A citizen-science site where volunteers' bird or water readings are checked, cleaned and charted every day
ideas.keywords: citizen science volunteers birds water readings data wildlife nature survey
ideas.loop: new readings arrive, outliers are checked and flagged, charts are rebuilt and flagged rows re-checked
ideas.measure: readings that fail validation and days since the charts were current, target 0
ideas.upkeep: volunteers submit new readings every day

ideas.text: A food-bank and free-clinic directory that re-checks every listing's hours each week and fixes what changed
ideas.keywords: food bank clinic directory charity free help listings hours community support
ideas.loop: every listing's own page re-checked weekly, changes applied, a listing that cannot be confirmed is marked unverified
ideas.measure: listings confirmed in the last 7 days, target all
ideas.upkeep: opening hours, addresses and services change all the time

ideas.text: An accessibility checker that audits our website every week and fixes what fails
ideas.keywords: accessibility a11y website audit disabled screen reader contrast wcag
ideas.loop: every page audited weekly, failures filed and fixed, the audit run again to prove each fix
ideas.upkeep: pages and content change every week

ideas.text: An ordering site for a bakery or cafe that learns what sells out and adjusts the menu and prep list
ideas.keywords: bakery cafe restaurant orders menu food shop small business stock
ideas.loop: orders read daily, the next day's prep list and menu adjusted, sell-outs and waste compared the day after
ideas.measure: items sold out early and items wasted per week
ideas.upkeep: seasons, prices and customer habits keep changing

ideas.text: A website for our club that keeps improving its search ranking and member features
ideas.keywords: club association website members community seo society group sports
ideas.loop: visits, searches and sign-ups read weekly, the weakest page improved, the numbers read again
ideas.measure: search ranking, page speed and new members
ideas.upkeep: events, content and security patches keep arriving

ideas.text: A volunteer roster for our charity that fills shifts, reminds people and learns who says yes
ideas.keywords: volunteer charity nonprofit shifts rota roster reminders community
ideas.loop: open shifts offered, reminders sent, who accepts is recorded and the next offer adjusted
ideas.measure: shifts left unfilled 48 hours before they start, target 0
ideas.upkeep: volunteers and shifts change every week

ideas.text: A grants desk for a small charity that finds new calls, drafts answers and tracks deadlines
ideas.keywords: grants funding proposals deadlines nonprofit fundraiser charity
ideas.loop: funder pages read weekly, matching calls filed with a draft, deadlines tracked to submission
ideas.measure: matching calls missed before their deadline, target 0
ideas.upkeep: funders open and close calls all year

ideas.text: A literature watch that reads new papers in my field each day and keeps a living summary with working citations
ideas.keywords: research papers literature science academic review citations study field
ideas.loop: new papers read daily, the summary revised, every citation re-checked so a dead one is replaced
ideas.measure: citations that no longer resolve, target 0, and days since the summary was revised
ideas.upkeep: new papers are published every day

ideas.text: A model evaluation harness that re-tests every new AI model release against its own history
ideas.keywords: model evaluation benchmark regression ai release llm
ideas.loop: each release run through the same tests, scores compared with history, regressions filed
ideas.measure: regressions found before a release is adopted
ideas.upkeep: models and providers release new versions every month

ideas.text: A language-practice tutor that adjusts each learner's drills to what they keep getting wrong
ideas.keywords: language learning tutor education students practice school course drills
ideas.loop: answers scored after each session, the next drills chosen from the misses, progress re-measured weekly
ideas.measure: repeat mistakes per learner per week, target falling

ideas.text: A household money tracker that sorts every bill, flags price rises and finds a cheaper plan
ideas.keywords: personal money budget bills household finance subscriptions savings prices
ideas.loop: each bill sorted as it arrives, rises flagged, cheaper plans checked monthly and the saving measured
ideas.measure: money saved per month and bills paid late, target 0
ideas.upkeep: prices, plans and providers change every month

ideas.text: A commute helper that reads live transit data and learns which routes really get me there on time
ideas.keywords: commute transit train bus travel route delays personal journey
ideas.loop: live departures read each morning, a route suggested, the actual arrival compared with the suggestion
ideas.measure: share of days the suggested route arrived on time
ideas.upkeep: timetables, works and delays change every week

ideas.text: A newsletter for my art or music that drafts each issue from what I made and learns what readers open
ideas.keywords: newsletter artist music art creative writing fans blog publish
ideas.loop: new work collected, an issue drafted and sent, opens and replies read to shape the next issue
ideas.measure: open rate and unsubscribes per issue
ideas.upkeep: new work and new readers every month

ideas.text: An open-source project's triage desk that labels new issues, finds duplicates and keeps docs in step with releases
ideas.keywords: open source maintainer project issues triage docs releases github developers
ideas.loop: new issues labelled and linked to duplicates, docs checked against each release and fixed
ideas.measure: issues without a label after a day and doc pages behind the release, target 0

ideas.text: A cost controller that watches our cloud spend and trims waste every week
ideas.keywords: cloud cost spend budget finops waste operations
ideas.loop: spend read daily, waste found and trimmed, the next bill compared with the forecast
ideas.measure: spend against budget and waste found per week
ideas.upkeep: usage and prices change every week

ideas.text: A fleet of services that finds its own failures, fixes them and proves each fix
ideas.keywords: services monitor failures fix incident reliability fleet uptime
ideas.loop: probes find a failure, a fix ships, a probe that turns red reverts it
